faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: How the template is built, and what you are expected to change.

question1.a: Stripe, Creem and PayPal, all three at once. They share a single plan definition, so a customer gets the plan they actually paid for regardless of which provider they used.

question2.q: Can subscribers cancel at any time?
question2.a: Yes. Cancellation runs through each provider's own customer portal, and access continues until the end of the paid period.

question3.q: How does the credit system work?
question3.a: Every plan carries a monthly credit allowance. Running a tool debits credits before execution and refunds them automatically if the run fails, so a failure never costs the user anything.

question4.a: Email + password and Google OAuth are both built in. Sessions are HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookies issued server-side, and the OAuth flow carries state plus a PKCE challenge.

question5.a: It ships with typed routes and server functions, deduplicated webhooks, an admin audit trail, rate-limited sign-in and SEO defaults. What it does not ship with is your tool.

question6.a: Drizzle ORM with two interchangeable drivers: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) for edge deploys and Neon (Postgres) for everything else. One schema, checked for parity by a test.

question7.q: How do I add my own tool?
question7.a: Declare it in app/lib/tools/registry.ts and implement the handler in app/lib/tools/server-fns.ts. Metering, logging and refunds keep working without any further changes.

question8.q: How do I change the design?
question8.a: Every colour, radius and font is a token in app/styles/globals.css. Change that one file and the whole site follows — ESLint blocks hard-coded palette colours in components so it stays that way.

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: We started with a simple idea: building a SaaS product shouldn't require months of setup and configuration. Every developer deserves a solid foundation to build upon.
story.paragraph2: This template was born from our experience building multiple SaaS products. We've included everything we wish we had when starting out - authentication, payments, analytics, and more.
story.paragraph3: Today, developers around the world use our template to launch their ideas faster, allowing them to focus on what makes their product unique.

termsPage.metaTitle: Terms of Service - Legal Terms & Conditions
termsPage.metaDescription: Read our terms of service to understand the rules and regulations for using our SaaS template.
termsPage.title: Terms of Service

s1.heading: Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By creating an account or using the service you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

s2.heading: Accounts
s2.body: You are responsible for activity that happens under your account and for keeping your sign-in method secure. Accounts are for a single user unless your plan states otherwise.

s3.heading: Credits and plans
s3.body: Paid plans include a monthly credit allowance. Credits reset at the start of each billing period and do not roll over. Running a tool consumes credits; failed runs are refunded automatically.

s4.heading: Billing and cancellation
s4.body: Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. You can cancel at any time from your dashboard; access continues until the end of the paid period.

s5.heading: Acceptable use
s5.body: You may not use the service to break the law, infringe others’ rights, or attempt to disrupt or reverse engineer the platform.

s6.heading: Disclaimer and liability
s6.body: The service is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our aggregate liability is limited to the amount you paid in the twelve months preceding the claim.

privacyPage.metaTitle: Privacy Policy - How We Protect Your Data
privacyPage.metaDescription: Our privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information. We prioritize your privacy and data security.
privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy

s1.heading: Information we collect
s1.body: We collect the email address, name and profile picture provided by your identity provider when you sign in, together with usage records for the tools you run and billing records for any purchase you make.

s2.heading: How we use your information
s2.body: Your data is used to operate your account, meter credit consumption, process payments, provide support and improve the service. We do not sell your personal data.

s3.heading: Payment data
s3.body: Card details are handled entirely by our payment providers (Stripe, Creem and PayPal). We never see or store full payment credentials — only the identifiers required to reconcile your subscription.

s4.heading: Cookies
s4.body: We set a strictly necessary, HttpOnly session cookie to keep you signed in, and a language preference cookie. No advertising cookies are used.

s5.heading: Data retention
s5.body: Account and billing records are retained for as long as your account exists and for the period required by applicable tax and accounting rules.

s6.heading: Your rights
s6.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us.
